name: hikvision-attendance-fullstack
description: Hikvision Attendance Management System deployed on Vercel with Supabase PostgreSQL

scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
